text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...*Pant*, *pant*,
...*wheeze*—*cough*.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, I-I'm exhausted... Well, of course I am.
My opponents are all worthy of the Grand Prix, after all.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(B-But... I shouldn't have shown
anything embarrassing...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-kuuuun!!!!
You were amazing, that was so cool--!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Graaand, great job!
That was an amazing run—!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... th-thank goodness.
They still acknowledge me—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, that was the absolute best, Cheval!!
Man, I can't wait for your next race~~!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she'll run the royal road in the autumn season too?
I kind of want to see her challenge the Fall Senior Triple Crown~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan E
text_block_list.text:
That sounds great! If it's you, Cheval,
becoming the third Triple Tiara winner in history might not just be a dream!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan F
text_block_list.text:
Damn, that sounds awesome, I wanna see it!!
So, what's next?
Gotta take on the world, right?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan G
text_block_list.text: "The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, right?! Wahhh, I wanna see Cheval-kun win so bad...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... a-ah, eh...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, autumn... I haven't even thought
about it at all yet...
Just finishing this race is taking everything I've got...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(The Autumn Senior Triple Crown? The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...?
S-Someone like me could never—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...Still—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan
text_block_list.text:
Cheval! Cheval!!
Cheval! Cheval!!
Cheval! Cheval!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Still, after she placed... so much hope in me...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...If I say I can't do it. If I show them such an unsightly side of me...
I'll surely disappoint them.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Letting them down... getting abandoned...
Having no one expect anything from me ever again...
And then—)

text_block_list.name: Club Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Cheval Grand?
Umm... Ah, AHH!!"

text_block_list.name: Club Trainer
text_block_list.text: The sister of Vivlos and Verxina! Ahh, now that you mention it, she did exist...

text_block_list.name: Club Trainer
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sorry. My two other sisters are so flashy,
so I guess I just don't stand out much, or—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Eeeeeeeeee——)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(My ears... feel kind of weird...
My hands are cold, too...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan
text_block_list.text:
"...The next race... soon—
It'll definitely be amazing... Autumn will be even more...—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...Right.
I need to try even harder...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan
text_block_list.text:
Not yet... even more...—
I'll definitely get stronger... so...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I have to try hard... I must try harder! More, more, more...!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Please make... please make
my training harsher!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I don't need time off after the race...! S-Starting tomorrow... No, if it's voluntary training, I can start today...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment she returned to the waiting room, she blurted that out—
I hurriedly stepped in to calm down her deeply cornered self.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet, as if barely hearing it, Cheval Grand continued on.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Please, Trainer!!
I want to get stronger!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Stronger... I have to become even stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
They acknowledge me.
They're cheering for me.
They're putting their hopes on me...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I have to live up to it.
I have to be someone who can meet their expectations.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Otherwise—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to go back to the old, pathetic me...
The me I hate so much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her hang her head in pain, I bite my lip.
...Deep down, I feel a strong sense of regret.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I should have anticipated it.
Inherently lacking confidence, overly serious,
and prone to cornering herself—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That she would face the fans' voices and expectations, take them to heart,
and end up taking them "too much" to heart.
...I should have realized it sooner.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer...
A-Anyway, I—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Train even more, even harder...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I can't just keep regretting things.
Late though it may be, as her Trainer,
I must do what needs to be done starting now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that resolution, I look Cheval Grand right in the eyes.
I meet her trembling, anxious gaze head-on.
choice_data_list: You have to rest right now.
You have to rest right now.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... B-But!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I mean, how could you... Trainer.
choice_data_list: I can't let you run in your current condition.
I can't let you race as you are now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Pushing through reckless training while feeling cornered can lead to irreversible injuries.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: All I could do for her as a Trainer was to force her to rest, even if against her will.
choice_data_list: Let's worry about what comes next another time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How had she taken my words?
Cheval Grand just stood there,
looking down in silence—
